name: Helio S.A.
summary: Helio S.A., a Polish enterprise founded in Zaborów in 1992, primarily specializes in the production and commercialization of pre-packaged dried fruits and nuts across Poland. As a subsidiary of Agora S.A., the company markets its extensive product line under the HELIO brand. Their offerings encompass a wide array of nuts, various dried and candied fruits, grains, poppy-seed fillings, fudge caramel masses, cake icings, and microwave popcorn. Helio S.A. distributes its products through major retail chains, wholesale distributors, and independent grocery establishments.
